responsibility: Provides the FT32 target configuration header that fixes the backend’s ABI-visible machine properties and compile-time macros. It defines register numbers and classes, fixed/call-used sets, pointer and scalar type sizes, stack/frame/argument-pointer conventions, register elimination and base-register rules, alignment and structure layout policies, assembler and linker specs, addressing-space setup including __flash__ program memory, and assembly symbol emission conventions, giving GCC the static target description that ft32.cc and ft32.md rely on.
same_name_distinction: Unlike ft32.cc’s hook implementations, ft32.md’s RTL patterns, and ft32.opt’s option declarations, this header is the static target-definition layer: it declares the FT32 machine model through preprocessor macros for registers, register classes, ABI/layout rules, address spaces, and assembler/linker conventions that the other same-stem files consume.
